description: This file defines a singleton class `RefreshBroadcast` used to broadcast refresh requests via an event `RefreshRequested`. It employs lazy initialization to ensure only one instance exists and provides a method `CallRequestRefresh` to invoke the event.

classes.name: RefreshBroadcast
classes.description: A singleton class providing an event-based mechanism to notify listeners to refresh, using lazy instantiation.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Invokes the `RefreshRequested` event to signal that a refresh should occur.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of `RefreshBroadcast`.
